items.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
items.summary: Ahead of a potentially record IPO, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called compute purchasing his 'deepest business dilemma', with commitments near $901bn and uncertain future revenue.

items.title: AWS Warns of MCP Gateway Registry Vulnerability Allowing Attackers to Access Internal Network Services
items.summary: AWS warns of a vulnerability in its MCP Gateway Registry that could let attackers reach internal network services — a notable supply-chain risk for agent tooling.

items.title: Cursor confirms security breach led to malicious Claude Code extension
items.summary: Cursor confirmed a security breach that resulted in a malicious Claude Code extension being distributed, a direct supply-chain risk for developers using AI coding tools.

items.title: Beware the New AI-Fueled Ransomware Boom
items.summary: Wired reports that fully automated ransomware has not arrived, but relatively unsophisticated attackers are already using AI tools to scale damaging campaigns.

items.title: ‘Jensen Huang lost his mind’: how AI’s smartest man fell for the world’s oldest trick
items.summary: The Guardian examines the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang amid allegations of an extramarital affair with a suspected spy, framing it as a landmark corporate espionage scandal for Silicon Valley.

items.title: Microsoft Research Details Dormant-Neuron Backdoor Risk in AI Agents
items.summary: Microsoft Research reportedly details a 'dormant-neuron' backdoor risk in AI agents, where hidden triggers can activate malicious behaviour in deployed models.

items.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
items.summary: TechCrunch reports Nvidia's security chief left in August, and a former intelligence officer says the kind of exposure behind Huang's exit—leaks via everyday relationships—is something most corporate security teams cannot detect.

items.title: US AI Safety Center Staff Asked to Report to the White House

items.title: Commerce Department under pressure for delaying export controls on Nvidia chips

items.title: Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5
